rationale: Reviewed the full branch diff (5 source files + lockfile). The upgrade is dependency-pinning plus two surgical code changes, verified by the complete regression suite rather than new tests (an upgrade must not change behavior, so the existing 4656-test suite is the specification). Blind pass: main.tsx non-null assertion mirrors the existing keycloakify entrypoint pattern and the #app element is statically present in index.html — safe. ProjectSelector change subscribes via useSnapshot(userStore) and re-runs loadProjects on user object identity change; the auto-select guard (!value) prevents onChange loops, handleFilter search flow is untouched, and extra reloads are cheap local reads. Edge-case pass: valtio snapshot identity changes on any user-subtree mutation, causing occasional redundant loadProjects calls - accepted (harmless, local). ChatPage panel id rename verified unreferenced: width persistence is keyed inside useChatSidebarResize, not by panel id; no selector/CSS references to the panel id exist; the harness page object targets the ChatSidebar aside which keeps the #chat-sidebar id. Dependency scope discipline held: only React-19-required bumps (react/react-dom 19.2.8, explicit @types 19.x, react-draggable 4.7.1, removal of deprecated @types/react-datepicker).
follow_ups: Report the duplicate #chat-sidebar id root cause to EPMCDME-13270 owners (fixed here minimally by renaming the older panel id; the redesigned aside keeps the id the test harness targets)
